[[Sprite Spring]] |Time = Any time |Season = {{Season|All}} |Weather = Any weather |Difficulty = 60 |Behavior = Mixed |Size = 4 - 9 |XP = |Edibility = 5 |base = 150 |Roe = yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a type of [[Fish]] that can be caught at [[Junimo Woods]] and [[Sprite Spring]] during any season, at any time, in any weather. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Map== {|class="wikitable" |style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Junimo Woods.png|center|500px|class=responsive-image]] || style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Sprite Spring.png|center|500px|class=responsive-image]] |- |style="text-align:center;"|Junimo Woods - Fish Zones || style="text-align:center;"|Sprite Spring - Fish Zones |} {{clear}} ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally '''disliked''' gift item, with the following exceptions: {{Gifting |love=Marlon |like=Wizard |neutral=Elliott, Linus |hate=Abigail, Andy, Claire, Clint, Demetrius, Evelyn, George, Gus, Haley, Jas, Martin, Maru, Olivia, Pam, Pierre, Sebastian, Shane, Sophia, Vincent, Willy }} ==Fish Pond== {{#lst:Fish|Glowfish}} ==Recipes== {{PAGENAME}} is not specifically used in any artisan, cooking, or crafting recipes but can be used in recipes calling for "Any Fish." ==Bundles== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any bundles. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|gold}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} produces a gold color. {{Navbox Fish}} [[Category:Fish]] [[zh:黄金鱼]]
